To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MoSCoE provides a framework for modeling Web service composition and execution.

1) the MoSCoE framework is the first approach that provides an incremental approach to service assembly and execution; 2) the MoSCoe framework provides a systematic approach for the composition of Web services that are not necessarily compatible with each other; and 3) the MoSCOE framework provides a systematic way to refine the service specification when it is not realizable.
MoSCoE is an approach for incremental Web service composition and refinement that is driven by a user's high-level service specification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an approach to the specification and assembly of Web services that is flexible, robust and user friendly, and which is based on a sound theoretical framework.

developing an integrated environment that supports the specification of composite services, the identification of the most appropriate composition strategy, the refinement of the composition specification towards a real-world implementation, and the execution of the composite service.
the development of new techniques and tools for the specification, composition, and execution of Web services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach provides a framework for modeling, composition, and execution of Web services.
the research proposed here would result in a new approach to service composition and execution that would be applicable to any Web service composition scenario.
MoSCoE provides a framework for modeling and executing composite Web services, which is a significant contribution towards the realization of the Web service vision.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed an approach and tool to model, compose, and execute composite Web services.
we have proposed a new incremental approach MoSCoE, for modeling Web service composition and execution based on the three phases of abstraction, composition, and refinement.
we have proposed and demonstrated an approach that allows for the incremental development of a composite service.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the composition and refinement process is not a one-time event, but rather a process that is iterated until the user is satisfied with the resulting service.
the MoSCoE framework provides a novel approach to Web service composition and refinement that is both user-centric and technology-independent.
the user is always in control of the process, and that the process is guided by a set of sound principles and a set of tools that are easy to use and understand.
